title: Binge-Trigger Map for Cutoff Breaches
dataSources: Alcohol habit events (`habit:alcohol`), caffeine intake (`habit:caffeine`), screen-time sessions (`habit:screen`), and fasting windows (`habit:fasting`).
app: Habit-boundary telemetry for Dry January, caffeine cutoffs, screen-before-bed limits, and fasting windows sent to Splunk HEC via apps, shortcuts, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=habit:caffeine
| search cutoff_breach=true
| stats count as breaches avg(caffeine_mg) as avg_caffeine_mg by trigger_name
| sort 0 - breaches
value: A trigger map helps you design around the moments that keep breaking the rule.
implementation: Send cutoff-breach triggers events to `index=personal` and keep `trigger_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of cutoff-breach triggers by triggers.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges which triggerss stand out most for cutoff-breach triggers.
